verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for an error-tracking SaaS with client libraries and a CLI, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of any opt-out for vendor telemetry or usage tracking, whether in the SDKs, the CLI, the MCP server or the web app. The one 'telemetry' mention (honeybadger-docs-24) is about customers sending their own job telemetry to Insights, not opting out of tracking.
